selection_history: Prior refit-policy-v1 aggregate results were known. This protocol fixes one new matched experiment with no threshold search and no new readout fitting.

background.source: Full actual147456 endpoint world and inherited h; frozen own_policy model. Execute its actual eleven-action argmax at every tick in all8 actors.
background.family: Change future family only; inherited pending contracts remain intact.
background.selection: Earliest eligible real NEW/REPLACE under the new regime and requested family in each lane/job/real-version stratum. No response score is used. Require the next scheduled target NEW/REPLACE/CANCEL to be strictly after cue+8+original window. Continue through the entire needed source-observation suffix.
background.anchor: Save full real post-observe/pre-act world, exact original observation, continuous pre-cue h and source post-cue h. Real version and kind are never relabeled or altered.

treatment.arms: 4 raw payloads x durations2,8 at each identical actual anchor; preserve real family, version, event kind, request identity, window and scheduler.
treatment.pulse: Only target job raw-payload one-hot and duration in the real cue observation are replaced. Mapped target follows the original family mapping. No hidden state, weight, previous receipt, context or version is replaced.
treatment.hash: Original event_hash remains the authentic scheduler prefix digest; intervention is separately fingerprinted and the complete mutated world hash is saved. It must not be mistaken for an unmodified scheduler event.
treatment.actions: Target executes its correct-version BEGIN at cue, then WAIT throughout. All non-target actor/job actions are locked to the recorded original own-policy background actions at the same absolute tick. Model argmax is measured but not executed in these forks.
treatment.receipts: Retain actual unmodified world-generated receipts. Fixed real version means identical BEGIN action/accepted result in all8 variants; WAIT yields no subsequent receipt. No FINISH is executed, so payload labels never enter feedback. Version is present in BEGIN receipt and is not isolated as a pure memory test.
treatment.equality: Assert every non-target public observation equals source background exactly, and every complete observation across all8 treatments is identical after cue. At cue only target payload/duration columns may differ.
treatment.legal: Use actual active+started and ready_time<=now<=deadline, after an actually accepted locked BEGIN; first observed legal time is not teacher midpoint.

observation.timing: All scores/features sampled post-model-step/pre-action. midpoint is duration/2 since actual locked BEGIN; common_age2 is common absolute cue-age2. teacher_first is first observed midpoint-oracle FINISH time; common_short_teacher is short-arm teacher_first absolute age in both duration arms.
observation.stage_duplicates: short first_legal=common_age2 and short teacher_first=common_short_teacher reuse the same state with different stage labels. Do not count these rows as independent samples.
observation.outputs: Unchanged actual11 logits, actual8 FINISH logits, uncentered original conditional affine offsets8, descending FINISH rank8, original FP64 non_input24 states; teacher and private-world labels are scorer-only.

analysis.primary: Within-anchor pairwise correct-versus-alternative target score differential, symmetric paired ordering and argmax distinction at equal duration/stage; per-seed descriptive summaries across four families.
analysis.timing: At common_age2 compare short legal vs long processing; at common_short_teacher compare short teacher-FINISH vs long processing. Separately report WAIT/BEGIN/FINISH argmax and FINISH-minus-best-nonFINISH margin.
analysis.heldout: Actors4..7 were held out from external readout fitting only; backbone saw all8. Independent probes must split whole anchor families of variants together and use actor4,5 train vs6,7 test then reverse; no score-selected model or hyperparameter changes here.
analysis.independence: Three seeds are the independent replicated units. Anchors, jobs, versions, treatments and stages are repeated nested measurements.

schema.rows: List of metadata dictionaries; all tensors use the exact same row order.

tensors.rank8: int64[N,8]; descending original FINISH scores; code4*version+mapped_payload

limits: Controlled real-world forks under locked operations, not autonomous policy behavior or completion evidence.
Duration changes preserve the original next-external-event scheduler; selection restricts analysis to an uninterrupted treatment window, so this is not a natural resampled duration regime.
Version is observed and fixed within an anchor, and its BEGIN receipt is retained. Raw payload is the isolated within-anchor content manipulation.
Only three seeds; paired discrimination and decodability do not establish learned causal use or native recurrent learning.
